say:1:1010613001:2.text: You there, tell me about these grapes right now!
say:1:1010613001:2.source_cn: 你们，这片葡萄田是怎么回事？！

say:2:1010613002:2.text: Calm down, why are you suddenly reacting so intensely?
say:2:1010613002:2.source_cn: ……你冷静点，怎么突然这么激动？

say:3:1010613003:1.text: Are you the ones spreading rumors about Lord Franz getting arrested?
say:3:1010613003:1.source_cn: 就是你们传言说弗朗茨老爷被逮捕了吗？

say:4:1010613004:1.text: What a load... Aside from being filthy rich, the guy's got connections with nobles all over the kingdom. Do you think he'd get locked up so easily?
say:4:1010613004:1.source_cn: 笑话，他家财万贯，和各方贵族都有往来，怎么会那么简单入狱。

say:5:1010613005:1.text: Once they let him go, the first thing he's gonna do is ask if we've done our jobs, so stay out of our business!
say:5:1010613005:1.source_cn: 等弗朗茨老爷被放出来，就该盘查我们的工作了，别来惹麻烦！

say:6:1010613006:1.text: Answer me! Did Lord Franz plant these grapes, too? When were they planted?
say:6:1010613006:1.source_cn: 回答我，这些葡萄也是弗朗茨种的吗？！什么时候？！

say:8:1010613007:0.text: The guy who worked the previous shift says that he planted them with some woman in black <style="highlight">three years ago</style>...

say:11:1010613008:1.text: Shut your trap, idiot! Don't tell them anything else! We ain't got any reason to answer you, now scram!
say:11:1010613008:1.source_cn: 闭嘴，别什么都往外说！\n我们没义务回答你，快滚！

say:12:1010613009:1.text: <style="highlight">Three years ago</style>, wasn't that before Southville planted their grapes in mass? If so, that means my <style="highlight">hometown</style>...

choice_prompt:13:1010613009.text: <style="highlight">Three years ago</style>, wasn't that before Southville planted their grapes in mass? If so, that means my <style="highlight">hometown</style>...
choice_prompt:13:1010613009.source_cn: <style=highlight>三年前，</style>那就是在南村大规模种植葡萄之前……？！在<style=highlight>我的家乡</style>被——

say:14:1010613010:1.text: But how did this happen? I have to find out!
say:14:1010613010:1.source_cn: 这究竟是怎么回事……我一定要问个清楚！
say:14:1010613010:1.male: But how did this happen? I have to find out!
say:14:1010613010:1.female: But how did this happen? I have to find out!

say:15:1010613011:1.text:
Considering they're connected to Southville's grapes, we should investigate.
And if they aren't willing to talk, we'll have to try something else.
say:15:1010613011:1.source_cn: 既然和南村的葡萄有关，调查清楚也好。\n要是他们不肯说...

say:16:1010613012:1.text: Relax, I won't go too hard on them!
